title: 落地了，就回家
logline: 深夜机场塔台，管制员苏青引导二十年前飞行教官周远航驾驶的晚点三小时航班安全落地，传递归家温情。

shots.narrationZh: 深夜的风，掠过跑道灯串
shots.narrationEn: Night wind sweeps over the runway light strings
shots.visual: Night airport control tower with circular windows, cold glowing radar screens, communication panels, a half-empty coffee cup on the desk, runway lights twinkling in the distance, Su Qing sits focused wearing a headset, her hair neatly tied up in a dark blue uniform shirt.
shots.ttsDirection: 冷峻沉静，语速偏缓，气息平稳，『风』『跑道灯串』轻加重音，带深夜值守的疏离感

shots.narrationZh: 南方三二八，塔台，五边风切变注意，可以落地
shots.narrationEn: China Southern 328, tower, wind shear alert on final, cleared to land
shots.visual: Close-up of Su Qing's hands on the control panel, headset on, focused eyes staring at the radar screen.

lines.zh: 南方三二八，塔台，五边风切变注意，可以落地
lines.en: China Southern 328, tower, wind shear alert on final, cleared to land

shots.ttsDirection: 专注沉稳，语速适中，气息稳，重音落在操作的精准感上，带职业管制的克制

shots.visual: Close-up of Captain Zhou Yuanhang in white uniform with four stripes, short black hair mixed with white, sitting straight in the cockpit, hand on the control yoke.

lines.zh: 塔台，南方三二八收到，减速至二百一十，请求主用跑道
lines.en: Tower, China Southern 328 roger, decrease speed to 210 knots, request main runway

shots.ttsDirection: 隐忍感慨，语速稍缓，气息微沉，『教官』带旧忆轻顿，克制又柔软

shots.narrationZh: 跑道湿滑，灯带铺平归途
shots.narrationEn: The runway is wet, the light strips pave the way home
shots.visual: Wide shot of the wet runway, landing lights on both sides lighting up the dark night, the plane is approaching in the distance.
shots.ttsDirection: 专业笃定，语速稍快，气息稳，『归途』重读带指向感，收束落地前的紧张感

shots.visual: Su Qing takes off her headset slightly, a faint smile on her face, looking at the approaching plane through the tower window.
shots.ttsDirection: 释然柔和，语速放缓，气息轻扬，笑意自然透出，带久别重逢的柔软感

shots.narrationEn: Once landed, it's time to go home
shots.visual: The plane lands safely on the runway, landing gear touches the ground, then the text "落地了，就回家" appears on the dark screen.
shots.ttsDirection: 温暖笃定，语速适中，气息平稳，『回家』重读带暖意，收束全片的释然感
